name: falcon-asm
description: GAS (AT&T) x86 assembly support backed by the falcon-asm language server: hover, diagnostics and semantic highlighting, plus inline asm in C and C++.

falcon-asm.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `falcon-asm` language server binary. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; `~/` is expanded to the home directory. Left at the default, `~/.local/bin`, `$GOBIN`, `$GOPATH/bin` and `~/go/bin` are also tried when `PATH` has no match. Changing it restarts the server.

falcon-asm.inlineAsm.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer C and C++ files to the server for hover and diagnostics inside `asm` statements. Off, the server only sees `falcon-asm` files. The inline asm highlighting grammar is unaffected. Changing it restarts the server.

falcon-asm.toolchain.enabled.markdownDescription: Run the compiler and assembler from `compile_commands.json` when a file is opened or saved, for assembler diagnostics, macro values and listing hints. Changing it restarts the server.

falcon-asm.toolchain.onType.markdownDescription: Also run the assembler on the unsaved buffer while typing (after a 400 ms pause), so assembler diagnostics, listing hints and size budget lenses follow the text without saving. The buffer is written to a hidden `.falcon-asm-<pid>-<n>-<file>` next to the source, so quoted includes resolve, and removed when the run ends. Needs `falcon-asm.toolchain.enabled`. Changing it restarts the server.

falcon-asm.inlayHints.listing.markdownDescription: Show the assembler listing as inlay hints: section offset and encoded bytes after each instruction line, padding size on `.org` lines. Needs `falcon-asm.toolchain.enabled`. Changing it restarts the server.

falcon-asm.inlayHints.registers.markdownDescription: Show register values the dataflow analysis tracks as inlay hints at interesting statements: `ah=42h dl=80h` before `int $0x13`, `dx=3FDh` at `in`/`out`, `ecx=C0000080h (EFER)` at `rdmsr`/`wrmsr`, the CPUID leaf, the value a control register receives, CR0 at far jumps. Off by default. Changing it restarts the server.

enumDescriptions: Use the `falcon-asm: level=` comment in the file, else `-march` from the compile database
falcon-asm.level.markdownDescription: Target x86-64 microarchitecture level for level diagnostics. Empty defers to a `falcon-asm: level=vN` comment in the file, then to `-march` in the compile database. Changing it restarts the server.

falcon-asm.compileCommands.markdownDescription: Path to `compile_commands.json`, overriding discovery (workspace root, `build/`, then walking up from the file). `~/` is expanded; a relative path is resolved against the first workspace folder. Changing it restarts the server.

falcon-asm.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and the falcon-asm server in the output channel.
